Subject: Train-the-Trainers request and initial scope

Hi Camila,

Thanks for taking this. Asteria is planning a "Train-the-Trainers" run for our internal AI enablement team — ~15 instructors across product & engineering who will then train the rest of the org. We're looking for a half-day session covering Console walkthrough + API enablement and a short follow-up Q&A (3.5 hours total).

Proposed window: Jul 26–30 or Aug 2–6 (US timezones).
Must-haves:
- Dedicated temporary sandbox with 15 seats and sample datasets
- API key with elevated throttling for demo traffic (no rate errors in lab)
- Training materials and an agenda in advance

Could you confirm availability and what lead time you need to provision the sandbox and seats? Procurement will need an invoice for training seats — looping in Liam (procurement) on any billing questions.

Thanks,
Emily Park
Learning & Enablement | Asteria Health
